notes.title: Welcome to Update 1.2b!
notes.notes:
In this update, we resolved an issue involving Secret #7 and Secret #9 that could cause a session to soft-lock upon leveling up when all six passives had been fully upgraded. 

This issue was reported by one of our dedicated adventurers on Discord, and we prioritized fixing it to ensure as few players as possible would be affected after unlocking and using the new Secrets added in Update 1.2. 

A special thanks to [b]@eabrace[/b] for identifying this issue. We addressed it promptly once we pinpointed the root cause.

Additionally, we included two other major fixes in this update:
[olist]
[*] [b]Passive Ability Learning with Secret #7[/b]: Previously, new passive abilities were only granted after reaching 100% on the one being learned. This forced players to learn and upgrade their passive abilities one at a time before learning a new one. This issue has been fixed to allow a smoother progression.
[*] [b]Loot Order in Chests[/b]: The loot order in chests was not behaving as intended, leading to major discrepancies, especially when using Secret #9. This has been addressed to ensure that when opening chests, the weapons, spells, or passives presented are handled in a randomized manner when the player rolls a dice to receive their reward.
[/olist]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Update 1.2![/h1]

With this update, a set of 3 new Secrets have been added as modes that will unlock when meeting specific requirements adding twists and turns as well as challenges to how you may approach the depths of Gallowspire.

Additionally, this update adds some quality of life improvements for some of the Martial Weapons that fell short in usefulness and power level in comparison to other available options.

[h2]NEW[/h2]
[h3]New Secrets have been added![/h3]
[list]
[*] Secrets 7, 8 and 9 are now available to unlock ;)
[*] Achievements tied to Secret 7,8, and 9  are now available.
[*] 2 Hidden Achievements tied to New and pre existing Secrets are also now available to unlock. Will you become the Dungeon Master?
[/list]
[h3]“Secret 9”[/h3]
[list]
[*] “Secret 9” is unique compared to all other modes currently available.
[*] There are restrictions as to when it can be used.
[*] Using [b]“Secret 9”[/b] will not grant completion status (Gold text) to other Secrets when used together but their bonus to Gold and EXP will be retained.
[/list]
A new Card has been added for those with a surplus of Gold in their caches. We hope that its expensive nature will bring a smile to the face of those who choose to collect and upgrade it.

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] All Flaming Skull enemy types are now immune to slowdowns.
[*] Minibosses are now immune to slow downs.
[/list]
[h3]Achievement Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Battle Medicine[/b] achievement has had its requirement reduced from 50 to 20.
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments to Martial Weapons[/h3]
A large number of changes have been made to the lesser used Martial Weapons in order for them to become more suitable and viable choices when using both the Rogue and the Fighter class. Please note that some of these changes are greatly related to and directly affect some of the new Secrets that were added.
[h3]Fighter & Rogue:[/h3]
The Gauntlet felt underwhelming and hard to use as it needed frontal positioning. This has been addressed by making Gauntlet now attacking nearby enemies. Rapier has been massively improved by increasing its size. Max level Rapier should now be a great option for Rogue and Fighter alike.
[b]Gauntlet[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed from frontal to nearby enemies.
[/list]
[b]Rapier[/b]
[list]
[*] Size has been increased.
[/list]
[h3]Fighter:[/h3]
The Lance has been greatly improved to be a focus-fire weapon that is now much faster and packs a much bigger punch.
[b]Lance[/b]
[list]
[*] Max DMG has been increased substantially from 300 to 1500.
[*] Cooldown has decreased.
[*] Range has been changed to be a fixed 6.
[*] Size has been decreased from 1.5 to 1.
[*] Can be manually aimed.
[/list]
[b]Longsword[/b]
The Longsword is meant to be the Fighter’s signature weapon that should be dealing high damage in an area near them as they risk themselves in melee range of enemies. This has been greatly improved for Fighter users in attempts to make this weapon more appealing to the melee playstyle.
[list]
[*] Starting cooldown has been increased from 1.5 to 2.
[*] Maximum damage has been increased from 260 to 500.
[*] Remains a frontal weapon for the Fighter that changes to double-hit when reaching 100%+,  effectively becoming a 1000 damage weapon when hitting an enemy twice.
[/list]
[b]Hammer[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage has increased.
[*] Size has been increased.
[*] Range has been increased.
[*] Cooldown has been set to a fixed duration
[/list]
[h3]Rogue:[/h3]
[b]Dagger[/b]
[list]
[*] Size has been changed from a static value of 2 to increasing value from 2 to 3.
[/list]
[h2]Class Abilities / Passives / Talent Changes[/h2]
[h3]Fighter[/h3]
[b]Ultimate Ability - Shield Wall[/b]
[list]
[*] Armor during Shield Wall has been increased from 25 to 50.
[*] Block rate during Shield Wall has been increased from 25 to 50.
[/list]
[h3]Rogue[/h3]
[b]Talent Passive Abilities[/b]
Some of the lesser used Talent Passives have had their values increased in order to make them more of an appealing choices for Rogue players.
[list]
[*] [b]Powerful sneak[/b] duration has been increased from 3 to 4.
[*] [b]Deadly Caltrops[/b] damage has been tripled.
[/list]
[h3]Wizard[/h3]
[b]Talents[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Force Mastery[/b] has had its power greatly increased per Rank.
[*] Rank 1 has been increased from 75% of your INT to 100%
[*] Rank 2 has been increased from 150% of your INT to 300%
[*] Rank 3 has been increased from 225% of your INT to 600%
[*] Rank 4 has been increased from 300% of your INT to 900%
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Pain Tolerance that was showing up as percentages instead of full values.
[*] Fixed an issue where Controllers could no longer toggle the Quest menu in-game
[*] Fixed an issue where Companions could not use Potions during both Local and Remote Coop
[*] Fixed some general text-related issues
[*] Made some major performance improvements
[/list]
[h2]Special Request[/h2]
[b]@Ghost78[/b] said he had nothing more to spend gold on. We made something new..  just for you!

Thank you for supporting us and let the search for the new Secrets begin!

notes.title: Update 1.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Update 1.1![/h1]

With this update, new Secrets have been added as modes that will unlock when meeting specific requirements adding twists and turns as well as challenges to how you may approach the depths of Gallowspire.

Additionally, this update will serve as a major quality of life update bringing improvement through many of the features previously present which should give a bit more breathing room to both new and returning players alike.

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[list]
 [h2]Secrets have been added![/h2]

[*] These are new optional modes that can be used upon unlocking them to add challenge to the adventures but also reap new rewards.
[*] Activating a Secret as part of your adventure can reward the player with [b]additional XP[/b] or [b]gold [/b]- sometimes both!
[*] Secrets can be stacked on top of each other - including their rewards - to gain more and more experience and gold.

[h2]20 new achievements [/h2] have been added to this update.
[*] You can complete these achievements by discovering and playing the new added secret modes.
[*] [b]12 of the 20[/b] released achievements will be available to unlock with this update. The remaining [b]8 hidden [/b]achievements will be unlockable with the next update as more secrets will be added.

[h2]Keyboard rebinding[/h2]
[*]A first iteration of keyboard rebinding has been added with this update. You can find them in Options > Key Bindings
As there are a large variety of hardware that may interact with this feature, please do not hesitate to report issues on our Discord server. Include the information about your hardware to help us find the underlying issue(s) and work towards fixes.
[/list]


[h1]BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[h2]Quests[/h2]
A massive change has been made to the quest reward system. When claiming your completed chest rewards, everything earned will now be allocated to all heroes - including the one that did not join on the last adventure!

Redeeming quests will give the displayed rewards (XP, attribute points and talent points) to each of the 3 characters. Since gold is not character based, the rewards behavior does not change.

[h2]Class HP Balance[/h2]
The Rogue and the Wizard’s HP pools have been increased to help out with early gameplay and give a bit of an added buffer to the higher difficulty levels. This will reduce the current gap between those two classes and the Fighter.

[h3]Rogue[/h3]
[list]
[*] Starting HP has been increased from 80 to 90
[*] HP growth per class level has been increased
[/list]
[h3]Wizard[/h3]
[list]
[*] Starting HP has been increased from 60 to 80
[*] HP growth per class level has been increased
[/list]


[h2]Potions[/h2]
We increased the potency of some potions and their upgrades.

[h3]Oak Potion [/h3]
[list]
[*] “Reflection” upgrade doubled in power
[*] Rank 10 has been changed from 300% to 600% damage reflected
[*] All other upgrade ranks have also been doubled from their previous values
[/list]

[h3]Energy Breath Potion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Base damage has been doubled
[/list]


[h2]Card Collections[/h2]
Most card collection sets have been revised and their usefulness has increased, making them more valuable to collect.

[h3]Set: Tools of the Trade[/h3]
[list]
[*] Card Upgrade Enhancement: Individual card ranks now boost bonuses by [b]+1.5%[/b] (previously +0.85%).
[*] Chest Time Reduction: Sets now reduce chest opening time by up to [b]+90%,[/b] increased from +51%.
[/list]


[h3]Set: Implements of War[/h3]
[list]
[*] Single Rank Upgrade: Damage bonus per rank increased from +3.33% to[b] +3.5%.[/b]
[*] Fully Upgraded Bonus: Total damage increase when fully upgraded is now [b]+630%,[/b] an overall increase of +30% from the previous bonus.
[/list]

[h3]Set: Salves & Elixirs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Each upgrade now increases potion duration by [b]+0.25s[/b], up from +0.1s.
[*] Fully Maxed Set Bonus: Completing the set now extends potion duration by [b]+18.75s[/b], an increase from the former +7.5s.
[/list]

[h3]Set: Rest & Comfort[/h3]
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Bonus Max Health per card rank increased to [b]+4%[/b] from +3.33%.
[*] Fully Maxed Set Bonus: Total additional health bonus upon fully maxing and upgrading all cards is now [b]+360%[/b], up from +299.7%.
[/list]


[h3]Sets: Light / Medium / Heavy Protection[/h3]
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Armor per card rank increased from +0.17 to[b] +0.2.[/b]
[*] Fully Maxed Set Bonus: Total additional armor bonus when all cards are fully upgraded has increased from +28.05 to [b]+33.[/b] This results in a total of [b]33% reduced damage[/b] taken passively when the set is maxed.
[/list]

[h3]Set: Lighting Up the Way[/h3]
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Darkness reduction per card rank increased from +0.53% to [b]+1%[/b].
[*] Fully Maxed Set Bonus: Total darkness reduction when all cards are fully upgraded and obtained increased from +47.7% to [b]+90%.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Set: Battle Medicine[/h3]
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Time reduction for reviving a companion per card rank increased from +0.85% to [b]+1.5%.[/b]
[*] Fully Maxed Set Bonus: Total time reduction when all cards are fully upgraded has been increased from 51% to [b]90%.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Set: Primal Power[/h3]
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Damage increase to Bosses and Mini Bosses per card rank improved from +0.75% to [b]+2%.[/b]
[*] Fully Maxed Set Bonus: Total increased damage dealt to Bosses and Mini Bosses after fully upgrading all cards of this set has been boosted from +56.25% to [b]+150%.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Set: Imposing Presence[/h3]
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Damage increase to Elites per card rank improved from +1.66% to [b]+2%[/b].
[*] Fully Maxed Set Bonus: Total increased damage dealt to Elites after fully upgrading all cards of this set has been boosted from +124.5% to [b]+150%[/b].
[/list]


[b]Damage Increase to Monsters:[/b] For all sets affecting damage to specific monster types:
[list]
[*] Individual Card Upgrade: Additional damage per card rank has been increased from +1.66% to [b]+2%[/b].
[*] Max Damage Increase per Card: Maximum additional damage per card has been raised from +24.9% to [b]+30%.[/b]
[*] Scope of Update: This change applies to 32 Monster Cards across various collection sets, enhancing their respective damage bonuses against designated enemy types.
[/list]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Projectile speed of all ranged enemies have been greatly reduced
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where HP bars would remain on screen when reaching the kill count required to move to the next level.
[*] Fixed an issue where, under specific conditions, your save could be corrupted and result in data loss.
[*] Fixed the purple portal that sometimes get stuck after a floor completion
[/list]


Thank you for supporting us and let the search for the Secrets begin!

notes.title: Major Update: Aiming & Collectibles
notes.notes:

This update is the result of your constant support and input. You’ve been instrumental in shaping it and we are thankful for everybody that shared their feedback since our Early Access launch, on both Steam and Discord. [*] [b]Collectibles: [/b]We are introducing a new meta progression feature. You can now find collectable cards by seeking Tar-Baphon statues throughout all levels. notes.title: Important Update : Dividing runs into Chapters
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you everyone for this first week of early access!
[/b]

Last week, we mentioned that significant changes were upcoming. The most recurring feedback received from you was about having a faster progression, shorter runs, and significant ability updates. We needed leveling to feel impactful.
 
We playtested our changes through the week-end with players and the feedback has been super positive. We can’t wait to get yours!


Here are the main changes in this patch:

[olist]
[*] Biomes & Story Progression: We’ve split our floors and bosses into separate runs.  We wanted players to have more control over their game and make the progression more personalized. In addition to the ability level-up and rarity adjustments done last week, the result is shorter, more dynamic runs.

[*] Enemies: While modifying the floors and progression, we also increased the number of enemies on each floor to make the run more dynamic, upgraded their health, and modified damage output depending on enemy types.

[*] Drop Rates: After altering progression, we wanted to also change the power scaling of players. We massively increased the drop rate of chests from unique enemies. We also increased the potion drop rate as we felt potions were not useful enough on certain floors.

[*] Bug Fixes: There were a few critical bugs that stopped players from progressing. They are now fixed.
[/olist]

[b][h3]Important note on your current save and your progression:[/h3][/b] In this new build, you will keep your difficulty progression. To choose your starting biome, you’ll have to unlock them one at a time.

For more details, refer to our complete [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2388460/view/3721718476539645559] patch notes[/url].

[url=https://discord.com/invite/69ePVUCf]Join our Discord server[/url] to be part of the discussion about the current and upcoming updates. Other changes are in the works, but we are waiting eagerly for how you feel this patch is improving your experience.

notes.title: Progression and quality of life Update
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

We're thrilled to have you with us during the Early Access phase of our game. Your feedback helps us toward making this game the best it can be, so keep it coming!

After reading all of your feedback and prioritizing what were the biggest pain points, we felt that changes were needed.

We are working on an update that we are aiming to release next week that will address our most frequent comments from the community. Meanwhile, we are releasing a first patch that includes quality-of-life upgrades and progression improvements.

Here are the main changes in this first patch:

[olist]
[*] [b]Ability Level-Up & Rarity Adjustments[/b]: We've made the ability upgrades more significant in terms of numbers and visual perception. XP needed to level up during an adventure doubled, but power gains per level-up significantly increased for more impactful choices.

[*] [b]Attack Slots Selection[/b]: Choose your first ability at the beginning of your run; no more automatic selection.

[*] [b]Chests[/b]: We felt like there were too many chests per floor, making a run more about chest chasing. We adjusted the spawn rate to make the gameplay sessions more dynamic. We also adjusted the rewards you get when killing bosses and mini-bosses.

[*] [b]Dice Roll Skip in Chest UI[/b]: We added the option to skip the animation to directly get the result of a roll. You should also know that you can completely skip animations in the Options menu of the game.
[/olist]

For more details, refer to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2388460/view/5560312482574528009] our complete patch notes[/url].

[url=https://discord.com/invite/69ePVUCf]Join our Discord server[/url] to be part of the discussion about the current and upcoming updates. We are also planning to make all our significant updates available to play by a few players prior to release. If you want to participate, please consult the Playtest channel for more details.

Thanks for being part of this community and helping the game grow!

The BKOM Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2010
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]


[list]
[*] Fixed a critical issue causing session halts when opening chests ("Chest Roll hang").
[*] Addressed an issue with Grave General's appearance during Phase 2 of boss encounters, eliminating session blockers.
[*] Fixed a problem where Istravek's second phase occasionally dropped too many Health Potions.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]


[list]
[*] [b]Attack Slots[/b]: Automatic selection removed; players can now choose their first ability at the start of a run.

[*] [b]Permanent (Meta) Progression[/b]: Doubled XP rewards and increased gold to expedite class leveling, especially in the early stages.

[*] [b]Adventure Progression[/b]: XP required to level up during an adventure doubled; power gains per level-up increased significantly.

[*] [b]Level Ups & Rarity Adjustments[/b]: Enhanced power gains for level-ups across different rarity types:
[*] Common Upgrade: +250%
[*] Uncommon Upgrade: +235%
[*] Rare Upgrade: +214%
[*] Epic Upgrade: +200%
[*] Legendary Upgrade: +166%

[*] [b]Adjustments to Mini-Bosses and Boss Chest Rewards[/b]: Rewards aligned with increased power gains per upgrade.

[*] [b]Bosses HP[/b]: Boss Health Pools slightly increased to match player power progression.

[*][b] Enemy Progression[/b]: Enemy health per floor slightly increased in response to player power growth.

[*] [b]Ability Numbers[/b]: Simplified ability values for clarity.

[*] [b]Fallback Strategy Passive[/b]: Consistent bonuses based on rarity.

[*] [b]Rewards[/b]: Chest availability is adjusted with a 30-second cooldown after opening before revealing the next chest location.

[*] [b]Invulnerability Time[/b]: Reduced invulnerability time between hits to 0.5 seconds for all classes.

[*] [b]Dice Roll in Chest UI[/b]: Added an option to shorten animations while keeping the dice roll.

[*] [b]Movement Speed Changes[/b]: Base movement speed increased for all classes:
[*] Fighter: +20%
[*] Wizard: +10%
[*] Rogue: +8%

[*] [b]Passive Changes - Fleet[/b]: Maximum Fleet bonus reduced from 50% to 35% when fully upgraded.
[/list]

[b]Developer Comments:[/b]


The "Fleet" passive has been adjusted to balance its dominance in various builds across all classes.


[b]Known Issues:[/b]
There is a known issue where fewer upgrade cards may appear during a level-up or at the start of an adventure; a fix is in progress for an upcoming update.

notes.title: Vampire Survivors-alike Pathfinder: Gallowspire Survivors has a release date
notes.notes:
Pathfinder: Gallowspire Survivors - a Vampire Survive 'em up set in Paizo's D&D-adjacent pen-and-paper setting Golarion - launches into Steam Early Access on 14th September 2023, Paizo and developer BKOM Studios have announced. If you're new to the much-imitated Vampire Survivors format, the idea is to steer an auto-attacking character around a map that is slowly invaded by increasingly hazardous waves of foes, levelling up as you go. Think of it as a bullet hell shooter, but set to the tune of a walking sim. At first, anyway: at higher levels, Vampire Survivors is a perfectly withering experience, for all its initial glacial pace.
